svg.title: The setpoint trial repeated with a sensor fault
svg.desc: With a 0.3 degree Celsius sensor fault the controller holds the reading at 38.00 degrees while the water settles at 37.70 degrees; the heater settles at 88.5 percent instead of 90 percent.
svg.text: The setpoint trial repeated with a 0.3 °C sensor fault
Simulator runs of this project · same heater, gains and 35 → 38 °C setpoint · numbers answer the predictions
